description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of tasks within a taxonomy for deep reasoning in speech, audio, music, and their mix. The chart is divided into ten slices, representing categories including Professional Knowledge & Reasoning, Spatial Analysis, Temporal Analysis, Correlation Analysis, Music Theory, Counting & Statistics, Environmental Perception & Reasoning, Speaker Analysis, Emotion & Perception, and Content Analysis. The slices are colored in shades of blue and purple, with “Cultural Layer” shown as 14.1%, “Semantic Layer” shown as 41.2%, and "Acoustic Quality Analysis" shown as 4.3%. A legend is present to the upper left of the chart, labeling each category with its corresponding color. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from larger to smaller proportions, though this is a visual observation. No slices are visually emphasized through exploding or offsetting.
